name: Creates new environment variables
description: Creates new environment variables Creates new environment variables. POST /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env
context:
POST /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env
Creates new environment variables. Granular scopes are available on Pro plans and above.
Required: account_id (path) — Scope response to account_id
Optional: site_id (query) — If provided, create an environment variable on the site level, not the account level; body (body)

name: Deletes an environment variable
context:
DELETE /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env/{key}
Deletes an environment variable
Required: account_id (path) — Scope response to account_id; key (path) — The environment variable key (case-sensitive)
Optional: site_id (query) — If provided, delete the environment variable from this site

name: Deletes a specific environment variable value.
description: Deletes a specific environment variable value. DELETE /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env/{key}/value/{id}
context:
DELETE /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env/{key}/value/{id}
Deletes a specific environment variable value.
Required: account_id (path) — Scope response to account_id; id (path) — The environment variable value's ID; key (path) — The environment variable key name (case-sensitive)
Optional: site_id (query) — If provided, delete the value from an environment variable on this site

name: Returns an AI Gateway token scoped to an account
description: Returns an AI Gateway token scoped to an account GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/token
context:
GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/token
Returns an AI Gateway token scoped to an account

name: Returns an individual environment variable.
description: Returns an individual environment variable. GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env/{key}
context:
GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env/{key}
Returns an individual environment variable.
Required: account_id (path) — Scope response to account_id; key (path) — The environment variable key (case-sensitive)
Optional: site_id (query) — If provided, return the environment variable for a specific site (no merging is performed)

name: Returns all environment variables for an account or site
description: Returns all environment variables for an account or site Returns all environment variables for an account or site. GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env
context:
GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env
Returns all environment variables for an account or site. An account corresponds to a team in the Netlify UI.
Required: account_id (path) — Scope response to account_id
Optional: context_name (query) — Filter by deploy context; scope (query) — Filter by scope; site_id (query) — If specified, only return environment variables set on this site

name: listAccountAuditEvents
context:
GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/audit
listAccountAuditEvents
Optional: query (query); log_type (query); page (query); per_page (query)

name: Updates or creates a new value for an existing environment variable.
description: Updates or creates a new value for an existing environment variable. PATCH /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env/{key}
context:
PATCH /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env/{key}
Updates or creates a new value for an existing environment variable.
Required: account_id (path) — Scope response to account_id; key (path) — The existing environment variable key name (case-sensitive)
Optional: site_id (query) — If provided, update an environment variable set on this site; body (body)

name: Updates an existing environment variable and all of its values
description: Updates an existing environment variable and all of its values Updates an existing environment variable and all of its values. PUT /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env/{key}
context:
PUT /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/env/{key}
Updates an existing environment variable and all of its values. Existing values will be replaced by values provided.
Required: account_id (path) — Scope response to account_id; key (path) — The existing environment variable key name (case-sensitive)
Optional: site_id (query) — If provided, update an environment variable set on this site; body (body)
